channel.title: Seven Life Areas
channel.description: Master every area of your life. Coaching for lasting transformation.

item.title: Why modern life is making us sick
item.description: Why an ancient body suffers in a modern world, and how to return to vitality.

item.title: Change yourself before you change the world
item.description: Becoming a creator of your life starts with self-mastery. We rush to change the world, but all seven areas of our life need to be developed first.

item.title: Two paths of creating through vision
item.description: Two paths shape the creation process: vision into action like Muhammad, or action into vision like Steve Jobs. Both bring a gift into the world.

item.title: Deep time and the seven generations
item.description: The clock measures life. Deep time reveals it. Use nature, ceremony, and ritual to slow down and learn to think across seven generations.

item.title: Why life feels so fragmented
item.description: Self-knowledge faded as Western culture fragmented, and when man split from nature, our lives fractured as well. We need a path to integration.

item.title: Follow your Heart, but don’t romanticize it
item.description: The Heart Life Area speaks through dreams and creativity. Learn to use it as a compass, and follow your passion.

item.title: Seneca on honor, fortune, and death
item.description: Honor is the only good that fortune cannot touch. Seneca taught how to live virtuously through chaos, loss, and the certainty of death.

item.title: How to balance all areas of your life
item.description: Seven Life Areas shape your reality. Balance comes from integrating all seven rather than elevating one above the rest.

item.title: How do I live a good life?
item.description: Seven Life Areas form a map for self-mastery, so you can live with alignment, achievement and purpose.

item.title: The Mind is a wonderful servant, but a bad master
item.description: Thought becomes action. Clear thinking, better systems and discipline compound into long-term mastery.

item.title: What is a mystical experience?
item.description: A mystical experience interpreted through Alan Watts’ drama model, Patrick Rothfuss’ true names, Carl Jung’s archetypes, and Plato’s cave allegory.

item.title: Plato and Aristotle on friendship
item.description: Compare Plato and Aristotle on the need for friendship by understanding virtue, flourishing, and self-sufficiency.

item.title: You become who you spend your time with
item.description: The relationships you choose shape who you become. Nurtured, they bring belonging and joy; neglected, they leave you adrift.

item.title: The architecture of self-mastery
item.description: Map your reality across the Seven Life Areas to eliminate blind spots and attain self-mastery.

item.title: Service is the key to fulfillment
item.description: Service is the center of the Seven Life Areas. It harmonizes Body, Mind, Heart, Matter, Spirit, and Relationships into one good life.

item.title: The seven masters
item.description: A fable of six masters who argue over a dying chestnut and how each carries a unique gift to bring it back to life.

item.title: Spend more time in the 3D world
item.description: Four hours a day on a screen is a decade of life. Why Body needs the 3D world and how to spend more time in it.

item.title: Die before you die
item.description: Spirit is the source of consciousness and meaning. Die before you die, and let the true Self shine through.

item.title: How to turn a vision into action
item.description: Creator OS helps align actions, projects, goals, and vision in one system, so you can make real progress in your work.

item.title: Build wealth, not status
item.description: Your relationship with money, career, and possessions either weighs you down or supports your freedom.
